issues.description: Duplicate db.sh entry/symlink will cause merge conflict and broken state
issues.detail: The PR both modifies egs2/TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh (adding TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads) and creates egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/db.sh as a symlink to ../../TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh. That's correct, but the diff shows db.sh appears TWICE in the PR (once as edited template, once as new symlink). Verify the symlink target resolves and the variable is actually picked up; otherwise the recipe cannot locate downloads.

issues.description: README links to a non-existent config path
issues.detail: README.md references `./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` (with extra `train/` subdir), but the actual file is at `conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml`. The displayed link text is correct but the URL target is broken. Fix the path so users can click through to the config.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh missing unzip does not exit
issues.detail: When `unzip` is not installed, the script prints a message but continues without exiting (no `exit 1`). Later `unzip` invocations under `set -euo pipefail` will fail with a confusing error rather than the clear diagnostic. Add `exit 1` after the warning.

issues.description: Missing zip files silently succeed instead of failing
issues.detail: If any of TAL_ASR-{1,2,3}.zip is missing AND the extracted directory does not exist, the script prints a 'please download' message but exits 0. data.sh then proceeds and fails later with cryptic errors from `find` on missing wav directories. Either exit non-zero when archives are missing, or check extraction state before continuing.

issues.description: Argument validation does not exit when usage printed
issues.detail: When `$# -lt 1` or `$# -gt 2`, the script prints usage but does not `exit 1`. Under `set -u` it then dereferences `$1` causing an unbound variable error. Add `exit 1` after the usage heredoc to fail cleanly.

issues.description: Hardcoded utterance counts will reject valid future dataset versions
issues.detail: data.sh hardcodes exact wav counts (22467/3208/6072/29386/38924) and exits with error on mismatch. If the upstream TAL dataset is updated, corrupted in transit, or partially downloaded, the recipe fails with no path forward. Consider a warning + minimum-threshold check rather than strict equality, or document the exact archive version this corresponds to.

review.summary: New ESPnet recipe for the TAL Zh Adult Teach ASR dataset following the standard egs2 structure. The main concerns are bash robustness in download_and_untar.sh (multiple code paths that print errors but fail to exit, causing confusing downstream failures under `set -euo pipefail`), a broken doc link in README.md to a non-existent config path, and brittle hardcoded utterance counts in data.sh that will reject any future dataset revision. The configs and run.sh look reasonable and consistent with sibling recipes; results are published with a HF model link.
